answer_4.quote: 60 annotators were randomly assigned to one of three groups of 20. Each group was given different guidelines to label the same 200 Twitter posts... as either hateful or non-hateful.
answer_4.guideline: G1, the descriptive group, received a short prompt which directed them to apply their subjective judgement ('Do you personally feel this post is hateful?'). G2, the prescriptive group, received a short prompt which discouraged subjectivity ('Does this post meet the criteria for hate speech?'), along with detailed annotation guidelines. G3, the control group, received the prescriptive prompt and a short definition of hate speech but no further guidelines.
